aiOverview.content: Na'Ziyah Harris was a 13-year-old Detroit girl who went missing in January 2024 and was later found to have been murdered by a man named Jarvis Butts. Case Details and Murder Disappearance: Na'Ziyah was last seen on January 9, 2024, after getting off a school bus in Detroit. Murder and Investigation: Prosecutors stated that Butts, 43, had been grooming Na'Ziyah since 2022 and killed her after discovering she was pregnant with his child. Evidence included search history for abortion methods and text messages. Legal Action: In February 2026, Butts pleaded guilty to second-degree murder and multiple counts of criminal sexual conduct involving other children. Sentencing: On March 12, 2026, Butts was sentenced to 35 to 60 years in prison. Current Status Body Not Found: Despite the conviction, Na'Ziyah's body has not been recovered. Authorities had been searching for her remains, and part of Butts' plea deal required him to disclose the location. Death of Killer: On March 26, 2026, just two weeks after his sentencing, Jarvis Butts was found dead in his cell at the Charles E. Egeler Reception and Guidance Center in Michigan, with the death reported as a suspected suicide. Family Impact: Na'Ziyah's family expressed concern that they may never find her body following Butts' death, with family members calling his suicide a "cowardly way out". The Detroit Police Department has stated they will continue their efforts to locate Na'Ziyah's body.
